mapper.select: SELECT hj.corp_gr AS corpGr , hj.jm_cd AS jmCd , hj.ksd_jm_cd AS ksdJmCd , hj.hj_nm AS hjNm , hj.pg_cd AS pgCd , hj.fund_cd AS fundCd , ia.fund_nm AS fundNm FROM SHM0HJ hj LEFT OUTER JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.corp_gr = hj.corp_gr AND ia.fund_cd = hj.fund_cd WHERE hj.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND hj.cash_cd IN ('ZS','ZF') AND hj.sanghw_ymd >= TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY hj.jm_cd ASC
